readmeSummary: Provides JavaScript-authored dynamic orchestration with agent, parallel, pipeline, verify, judgePanel, bounded retry/gate helpers, resumable journals, model routing and optional worktree isolation.
envReads: Model-provider and Pi runtime configuration are consumed through the host model registry
No package-specific credential environment read was found in the reviewed workflow extension paths
networkAccess: An optional web-research toolset can fetch URLs, but the meeting workflow does not select that toolset
fileWrites: Run journals, locks, results and saved workflows under ~/.pi/workflows
Optional persisted child Pi sessions when explicitly enabled
processExecution: Uses array-argument execFile calls for optional git worktree creation/removal and diff inspection
promptInjectionRisk: Workflow scripts can delegate arbitrary prompts and tools. This project supplies bounded, schema-validated meeting plans, project-owned read-only agent types, explicit concurrency limits and no automatic worktree isolation for meeting-content analysis.
credentialHandling: Model credentials remain host-managed. Meeting workflows do not expose environment variables, do not enable bash/write tools for specialist agents and do not persist child sessions by default.
disableOrUninstallPath: Remove the node_modules/@quintinshaw/pi-dynamic-workflows resource paths and dependency from meeting-agent-pi-package/package.json, reinstall dependencies, then reload Pi.
smokeEvidence: Pi 0.84.1 RPC loaded the workflow extension from the bundled resource path
get_commands exposed workflow control, model tiers and built-in patterns
meeting_agentic_plan produced a bounded six-specialist schema-validated workflow
The installed package parseWorkflowScript accepted the generated meeting-evidence-review workflow
A real three-topic run completed seven agents across specialist, completeness, verification and synthesis phases
The smoke surfaced out-of-transcript segment ids; parent reconciliation now quarantines such output and feeds violations to QA instead of trusting workflow synthesis
npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities after dependency upgrades
